sampling_contract: The ideal sampler draws ceil(log2(N-1)) fair bits and rejects values outside 0..N-2, then adds one. A separate fair bit selects the matching after a unit draw. This finite run replaces the fair bits with independently seeded Python Random.getrandbits streams.
solver_isolation: arithmetic_walk receives only N, a, method, and cap. Hidden r remains in this outer driver. Offline p,q are retained labels only.

offline_labels.usage: retained label; not supplied to arithmetic_walk

solver.state_scope: The transition retains one current rank. Four fixed-size prefix snapshots are measurement output, not path-search state.
